subject.title: [Bug]: Inbound message not delivered to idle claude-stdio warm process; session sits 'done' until no-output watchdog (600s) respawns it (WhatsApp, macOS, 2026.6.1-beta.1)

question: Is shipped #95039 plus #91974 proof sufficient to close #89388, or should #89388 stay open until a current-main warm `claude-stdio` post-idle WhatsApp reproduction is proven or disproven?
rationale: The adjacent fixes are real and shipped, but the exact issue describes a first post-idle inbound to an alive warm Claude process, and the current tests do not exercise that transport/runtime handoff.

options.title: Require live proof before close
options.body: Keep #89388 open until a current-main or v2026.6.11 warm `claude-stdio` WhatsApp smoke proves the first post-idle inbound wakes the existing process or captures the stale owner.

options.title: Accept adjacent fixes as sufficient
options.body: Close only if maintainers intentionally accept deterministic queue/live-session owner proof from #95039 and #91974 despite no exact transport smoke.

options.title: Queue a targeted repair after proof
options.body: Start repair only after the proof identifies whether the stale owner is reply admission, CLI queue identity, live-session stdin, or WhatsApp delivery.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before close
recommendation.body: Keep #89388 open until a current-main or v2026.6.11 warm `claude-stdio` WhatsApp smoke proves the first post-idle inbound wakes the existing process or captures the stale owner.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc verified the owner-key CLI runner fix and is the best available decision owner for whether that proof is enough for this exact warm-session issue.
